intro.title: 10 Mukhi Rudraksha Bracelets
intro.description: A fine range of bracelets made from natural 10 mukhi Rudraksha beads. Designed in silver and thread using our careful stringing approach so the beads settle well with the wearer while looking refined. Wear them daily to receive fuller benefit. 10 Mukhi Rudraksha carries the grace of the ten incarnations of Lord Narayan. It is sought for happiness, prosperity, peace, protection, and ease from debts, losses, and planetary afflictions.
